verdict.rationale: Motion's docs confirm multi-calendar consolidation across Google, Outlook, and iCloud into one view (motion-docs-8) and its AI scheduling algorithm automatically slots tasks/meetings to avoid conflicts (motion-docs-3, motion-docs-10), implying conflict-aware booking. However, there is no explicit documentation stating that conflicts across all connected calendars are actively checked/prevented, nor any independent or hands-on verification of double-booking prevention. Missing for 10: explicit conflict-detection documentation, independent user testimony confirming no double-booking across all three calendar types, and edge-case handling details.
